mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, o.nickname AS owner_name, n.ncr_no, v.nickname AS verified_by_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_capa_step st WHERE st.capa_id = c.id AND st.done = 1) AS done_steps FROM qms_capa c LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id = c.owner_id LEFT JOIN qms_ncr n ON n.id = c.ncr_id LEFT JOIN sys_user v ON v.id = c.verified_by LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = c.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM qms_capa c WHERE c.status <> 'CLOSED' AND c.due_date < #{today}
